materialBlockers: The frozen Round 3 workflow required the historical raw run's embedded pull_requests[].head.sha to equal that run's head_sha, but GitHub rewrote the embedded PR head SHA to the current PR head after C1 was pushed, so exact-head C1 CI could never pass.

The Round 3 design had no event-time provenance member inside new CI artifacts, so removing the mutable embedded PR SHA check without adding a durable replacement would weaken the base/head provenance chain.

observedApiBehavior.observation: The Actions run-level head SHA remained historical while the related pull-request object reflected the PR's newer head. Therefore the related pull-request SHA fields are live relationship metadata, not immutable run provenance.
